primary_task: Evaluate a Claude Code plugin or skill by running the plugin-eval static analysis (plus an LLM judge at standard depth) and report a composite score and badge.

requirements.name: uv
requirements.evidence: 1. Run Layer 1 (static analysis) via the Python CLI ... `uv run plugin-eval score <path> --depth quick --output json`
requirements.basis: "bash": "run shell commands on Linux x86_64: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)"

requirements.name: plugin-eval
requirements.evidence:
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
uv run plugin-eval score <path> --depth quick --output json
requirements.basis: The manifest does not list a plugin-eval CLI or say that the plugin is installed at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; "skill": "load an installed Claude Code skill, list and search skills and plugins" allows checking.

requirements.name: agent
requirements.evidence: 2. If standard+ depth: Run Layer 2 (LLM judge) by dispatching the `eval-judge` subagent
requirements.basis: "agent": "start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them"

notes: Unknown: whether the PluginEval plugin (its plugin-eval Python project and the eval-judge agent definition) is installed in the session at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; check with the skill tool or by listing the plugin directory. If absent and not obtainable from PyPI/GitHub, Layer 1 cannot run and the verdict would turn BLOCKED. uv itself is on PyPI. The eval-judge step is only for standard+ depth, so it is not hard for a quick evaluation.
